adjudication.rationale: Beyond the (true) “no tests added” point, the diff contains concrete defects: (1) `minimumTokenResponseSchema` in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts` tries to use computed keys like `[z.string().toString()]`, which evaluates to a single literal key (e.g. "[object Object]") rather than “any string key”, so the schema is effectively broken. (2) `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the Zod `safeParse` result object, but `GoogleCalendarService` stores that wrapper directly into Prisma (`const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(...); ... data: { key }`), meaning it would persist `{success, data,...}` instead of the credential payload. These are real, diff-verifiable correctness issues that a unit test would likely catch.
